issues: Two changes are bundled: seed-averaging (3 seeds per family) and a feature/capacity change (LGBM and CatBoost now see only the descriptor+ERG block, fingerprints dropped; CatBoost iterations 500 -> 300). Their individual effects cannot be separated from this comparison.

Observed gain (0.0114, z = 1.33) is within the stated 0.0070 noise sd; the ~3x increase in fits per fold is a large complexity cost for an unproven gain, which conflicts with the 'simpler is better' guidance.
Runtime headroom is now much smaller (9 fits per fold instead of 3); both runs completed, but the margin against the 10-minute cap is unverified.
